debrief db-021

5) the a-c-t-o-r a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the w-o-r-k-s-p-a-c-e u-n-d-e-r the s-t-a-m-p e-x-h-i-b-i-t-0-2-1 a-n-d l-e-f-t a f-i-n-a-l i-n-d-e-x f-i-l-e in the a-r-c-h-i-v-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-u-s-t-o-d-y c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
